violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: OBSERVED NO SANITIZER IN THE KITCHEN AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. BLEACH WAS OBTAINED DURING THE INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE THE KITCHEN IS ALWAYS PROPERLY SUPPLIED WITH A FORM OF SANITIZER AND THAT ALL STAFF UNDERSTAND HOW TO PROPERLY SANITIZE DISHWARE/FOOD CONTACT SURFACES.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name: OBSERVED TWO BOTTLES OF DISH DETERGENT WITHOUT LABELS.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. PIC ADDED LABELS TO THE BOTTLES DURING THE INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS CLEANING BOTTLES SHOULD ALWAYS BE LABELED.
